# Local Native Shell patch

Source: `nsh-platform-macos` 0.4.0 from crates.io, upstream commit
`e626a8dd8f8d8b277b9507cfd5ac74d0e67020f3` (`crates/nsh-platform-macos`)
in <https://github.com/longbridge/nsh>. Apache-2.0, see LICENSE.

The functional change is in `src/text.rs::system_font`: preserve the requested CSS numeric
weight through CoreText's `wght` variation axis. AppKit's named semibold is
590 on the current system font; `font-weight: 600` in Chromium is 600. This
fix applies to actual text painting, native editors and font measurement.
It does not substitute reference measurements or change layout tolerances.
Its regression test checks that CoreText receives the requested numeric weights.

The workspace patch and `.cargo/config.toml` both resolve this copy. The
latter covers the separate host workspaces generated by the NSH CLI.
Remove the patch when an upstream release preserves numeric variable weights.
